title: K1100h scoping: TAIFEX TX tick-level data readiness + PRG experimental design (no estimation yet)
description: K1100g_d6-d8 都卡在 daily/weekly 尺度, DM |t| borderline 皆小於 Harvey 3.0. K1100h agent 衍生假設: only tick-level 才能揭示真正 periodic structure. 本任務是 K1100h 的 Phase 0 scoping — 不跑 estimation, 只做 data readiness + experiment design. Scope: (1) 用 skill external-data-sources 查 TAIFEX TX tick data path (用戶 Dropbox 2017-2021); (2) 讀 3 個樣本檔 (任 3 個 trading days) 驗證 schema: 欄位名、格式、時區、tick 頻率、連續合約/主力月合約轉倉規則 (參考 CLAUDE.md: 不可直接把 TX1 當永久連續合約); (3) 比對 K1100g daily 用的 TAIFEX daily data 能 re-aggregate 對上; (4) 寫 experiments/k1100h/README.md (K1100h Phase 0 Scoping), 含 7 節: Problem (為何要 tick-level), Motivation (K1100g_d6-d8 failure 摘要), Data (path/schema/coverage/quality issues), Method (PRG estimation plan on tick grid: 小時內 intraday pattern, periodic dummies, aggregation to 5-min / 15-min), Expected Output (sample estimate / DM test design / Harvey threshold), Risks (tick data noise, rollover bias, dayboundary handling, seed-fix for bootstrap), References (K1100f/g knowledge refs). Hard rules: 不動 knowledge.json/research_program.md (supervisor 專屬); 不跑 estimation; 不 commit; 不用 dangerous git. 成功標準: README.md 存在且含上述 7 節, 對每個 Risk 給具體 mitigation. 完成後 ops finish-task 回報, signal_payload 列 data path confirmed + any schema surprises + proposed next task (K1100h Phase 1 implementation).

knowledge_candidates.topic: TAIFEX tick data readiness for intraday PRG
knowledge_candidates.one_line_finding: TAIFEX TX tick 資料路徑 + 2017-05-16 起 10 欄 schema 穩定；tick→day-session OHLC re-aggregation 與 K1100g daily cache 2020-06-15 完全吻合 (11356/11446/11216/11229)；可直接進 Phase 1 intraday PRG 建構
K1100g cache 的 is_settlement flag 對 2018-03-21 (第三週三) 為 False、2021-11-17 (亦第三週三) 為 True；K1100h Phase 1 要自己重算 settlement (weekday==2 and 15<=day<=21)，不要 reuse
TX1 檔在 settle day (第三週三) 仍是 expiring 合約 (2018-03-21 TX1 到期月份=201803)，intraday pricing 受結算干擾；K1100h Phase 1 改用 TX (全合約) + daily volume-based active contract picker (K849 rule)

K1100g_d5-d8 daily-scale borderline (+1.49 / +2.32 未過 Harvey) 的瓶頸在 daily aggregation 把 intraday periodic structure 平均化；tick→15-min/5-min grid 是 Paper 3 narrative 是否能升級到 intraday-periodic anchor 的下一步 lever

experience_candidates.lesson: Scoping 任務必須做小樣本 re-aggregation sanity check (3 random days) 對齊既有 daily cache，發現 (a) schema 斷點 (b) legacy flag bug (c) contract-month settle day 陷阱，才能讓 Phase 1 不踩坑
experience_candidates.context: K1100h Phase 0: 3 樣本 tick 檔驗證發現 K1100g is_settlement flag off-by-year、TX1 settle day = expiring contract 兩個 legacy trap，若 Phase 1 直接 reuse 會重製 K1100g_d6 d8 的 daily borderline 結果
